reponse: Daniel Levi owns Fernhill SAML end to end [1][3]. The Linear ticket KES-430 is due November 27, an internal buffer before the contractual deadline [1]. The contract commits SSO live in production by December 1, 2026, with a 10% credit on the Q1 invoice if missed [2]. Work is progressing: the ACS endpoint and signature validation were merged on Nov 14, and staging login works against Fernhill's test IdP [1][5]. The remaining blocker is Fernhill's production IdP metadata, expected on November 26 at the earliest after their change board [1][6].
